brands.name: Ahuja Radios
brands.description: Ahuja Radios is India's leading manufacturer and exporter of public-address equipment, established in 1940 by A. N. Ahuja with production starting in 1942. It operates factories in Delhi, Noida and the Mumbai SEZ, supplies more than 400 retailers across India and exports to over 50 countries. Ahuja PA World is an authorised dealer of the full Ahuja Radios range.

products.name: Ahuja BR-250M Power Amplifier
products.shortDescription: 250 W high-wattage PA power amplifier with switchable inputs and DC backup.
products.description: The Ahuja BR-250M delivers 250 W of power with switchable line inputs (200 mV or 1 V) and a resettable breaker for protection.
